name: codata-constants
title: CODATA 2022 constants
description: The 355 CODATA 2022 recommended values with NIST-published values, uncertainties, units, and exact and SI-defining flags.

// CODATA 2022 recommended values, parsed from the NIST Fundamental
// Physical Constants complete listing (physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants).
// Values and uncertainties are reproduced as published. NIST does not
// endorse this component. Exact constants carry no uncertainty.

export type PhysicalConstant = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Conventional symbol for the featured constants. */
  symbol: string | null;
  /** Value exactly as NIST prints it, including group separators. */
  value: string;
  /** Absolute standard uncertainty in the same unit, or null when exact. */
  uncertainty: string | null;
  exact: boolean;
  /** Unit exactly as NIST prints it. */
  unit: string;
  featured: boolean;
  /** One of the seven constants that define the SI base units. */
  siDefining: boolean;
};
